programme.desc: Ruby og Johnny fandt sammen over fotografering, men Ruby føler ikke, at Johnny fokuserer nok på hende.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Disstopia
programme.desc: Kirk finder endelig ud af hundehuset. Yandy vil finde ud af, om Mendeecees vil holde sine løfter. Koncerten falder ikke i god jord hos Scrappy.

programme.title: Ink Master: Step It Up
programme.desc: Coachene træder til under holdenes lyndyst. Opfindsomheden bliver testet med mash-up tatoveringer.

programme.title: Ink Master: Blæk på den stiplede linje
programme.desc: Præcisionsfærdighederne bliver sat på prøve, da artisterne skal lave et mesterværk med hullemaskiner.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Tuffs oprejsning
programme.desc: Oprejsningen bliver et familieanliggende, da to rasende lærreder vender tilbage med hver sin rasende pårørende.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Red & Jalissa
programme.desc: Red har talt med Jalissa og hendes gruppe af kendisvenner i seks år. Nu skal han møde Jalissa.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Gemini & Myranda
programme.desc: Efter syv år med drama er Gemini desperat efter at finde Myranda. Nev og Kamie beder om hjælp under deres første intervention med en serie-catfish.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Jason & Keith
programme.desc: I det første virtuelle afsnit af 'Catfish' hindrer karantænen ikke Nev og Kamie i at hjælpe Jason med at finde ud af mere om Instagram-modellen Keith.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Ryan & Micah
programme.desc: Ryan søgte kærlighed og mødte Micah på Tinder. Han troede, han havde fundet sin karantæne-kæreste, men da Kamie og Nev begynder at grave.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Artis & Jess
programme.desc: Tidligere deltagere fra Catfish: The TV Show sæson to tager plads i MTVs studie på Times Square for at besvare seernes nysgerrige spørgsmål.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Screenshots affyret
programme.desc: Sierra prøver at genvinde sin plads i Rennis babysitterklub. Saucy åbner op om en traumatisk oplevelse med en eks. Jessica afslører over for Yandy.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Desværre... Hun er min hustru
programme.desc: Efter 18 år sammen, og meget utroskab før i tiden, mistænker Jennifer, at hendes mand Sal er i gang med sine klamme metoder igen og risikerer alt.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Russell & Destiney
programme.desc: Russell ghostede Destiney for to år siden da hun fortalte ham, at hun var gravid med hans barn, men nu har han indset.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Han har slået Ken ud
programme.desc: Jamisons forlovede Juliette har ikke villet beslutte en bryllupsdato. Nu tror han, det skyldes hendes ven og frisør.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: En enestående drejning
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt i finalen, hvor de sidste fire par kæmper om de sidste stjerner.

programme.title: Ink Master: Tilbage til tegnebrættet
programme.desc: Kampen om en salon fortsætter, da deltagerne tatoverer dyr fra hjembyen. Nogle må tilbage til tegnebrættet, og slaget er kun lige begyndt.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XXXIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness føler Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood smerte af at hoppe i Triste gyngespring.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XXXIV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness hilser Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood på nogle Sure søfolk.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XXXV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness lærer Rob, Steelo og gæst Lolo Wood, at selv dommere kan blive ramt i RAMTE DOMMERE.

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Alicia Keys: Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys optræder i Unplugged på Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Glasmosaik fra fortiden
programme.desc: Sarah Miller er tilbage i Ink Master-salonen for at udfordre Steve Tefft. Miami Burgess er tilbage for at udfordre Big Ceeze i den tatovering.

programme.title: Ink Master: En klæbrig affære
programme.desc: Et splittet Team Peck kæmper for kontrollen over konkurrencen i en Lynudfordring i kontraster. En kunstner vender op og ned på pigernes alliance.

programme.title: Ink Master: New School, Gamle ar
programme.desc: I en hård lynudfordring skal kunstnerne tatovere eksrygere, der er mærket for livet.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXXXIV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness ser Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood nogle folk blive snydt i ELENDIGT TØMMER.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXXXV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness prøver Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood at komme i form med RISIKO-PULLUPS.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: En enestående drejning
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt i finalen, hvor de sidste fire par kæmper om de sidste stjerner.

programme.title: Celeb Ex In The City: Josh Ritchie and Bobby Norris
programme.desc: Bobby falder for sin date, men rystes han af sin eks Matt, som han ikke har set siden bruddet? Josh får en tur i London Eye, men ender det i gråd?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Mødre i krig!
programme.desc: Geordierne tager i zoo for at more sig, men udflugten ender katastrofalt. Da rodet i huset bliver for meget for nogle, starter det et skænderi.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Matt Rife
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness byder Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood velkommen til gæsten Matt Rife og møder folk, der TÅLER INGEN JOKES.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXXIX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness diskuterer Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood den passende alder at besøge skateparken i BØRNEKOLLISIONER.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Lolo Wood CCXXX
programme.desc: Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood oplever Hand Trippin'; se folk beskytte deres ejendele mod fjerklædte forbrydere med Bird Jacked-logo.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXXXII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness tager Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood i centret og SHOPPER OG DROPPER.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXXXVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness holder Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood fast i styret i FRONTALCYKLISTER.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXXXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculous glider Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood på nogle sted og bliver STENKØRT.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXL
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness bliver Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood ramt under bæltestedet i SKRIDTSLAG.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood CXLI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness tager Rob, Steelo og Lolo til SLAGRALLY, er farlige med en kø i BILLARDTUMPERNE og gør ting værre.

programme.title: Teen Mom: The Next Chapter: Pumping The Breaks
programme.desc: Briana og Bobby slår op. Amber kæmper med besøgsplanen for hendes søn, James. Jane er bekymret for, at Kloie ikke spiser nok.

programme.title: Teen Mom: The Next Chapter: Admit What You Have Done
programme.desc: Der er en uge til Cheyennes bryllup og hun bliver forlegen, da hun indser, at hun ikke har købt en ring til Zach.

programme.title: Teen Mom: The Next Chapter: Patient Love
programme.desc: Det er sæsones store samleafsnit. Der er ikke et øje tørt, da Zach og Cheyenne endelig bliver gift. Et biluheld bringer Ashley og Hollys liv i fare.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Dropping All Kinds of Eggplants
programme.desc: Før hun begynder på fertilitetsbehandling vil mistænksomme Star sikre sig.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Jeg føler mig som Sidespringet
programme.desc: Jessica mente, at forholdet til musikermanden var ren harmoni, indtil hun indså, at båndet til hans bedste ven har en mistænkelig klang.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: What is the Gardener Doing Here?
programme.desc: Kori beder Tami om hjælp for at se, om kæresten George er utro, men alt forandrer sig, da Tami indser, at hun selv er involveret.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Det handler kun om Big Ben-jamins, baby!
programme.desc: London kalder! Spice tager en del af Love & Hip Hop-holdet med over Atlanten for at optræde med castets album på Unruly Fest.

programme.title: Ink Master: Frem med hagen
programme.desc: Coachene skal foregå med et godt eksempel, da de tvinges til at tatovere under hagen i masterdysten.

programme.title: Ink Master: Tigerens øje
programme.desc: Gruppedynamikken sættes på prøve, da en stafetdyst ryster konkurrencen i sin grundvold.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Oprejsning og opgør
programme.desc: Når et 2-på-1 lærred er utilfredst, bliver to artister syndebukke, men kun én får chancen for at få oprejsning. Regnskabets time er kommet for E.S.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Prophet & Trinity
programme.desc: Prophet, fra Grammynominerede Nappy Roots, vil gøre comeback og har samtidig fået kontakt med Trinity på nettet. Hun er en model.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Kayla & Courtney
programme.desc: Da Kayla var 2 år, slog faren hendes mor ihjel og begik selvmord. Mange år senere får Kayla en besked fra Courtney, en kvinde, der påstår.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Lucas og Many
programme.desc: Den tidligere Playboy-model Jayme har opdaget, at hendes fyr på nettet ikke bare er falsk, men at han narrer flere kvinder.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Spencer afslører en hemmelighed for Nev og Max, som han har holdt for sig selv i seks år. Han har et forhold til en af verdens største popstjerner.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Sheila & Rich Dollaz
programme.desc: Nev og Nick Young, aka Swaggy P, prøver at hjælpe Sheila med at finde ud af, om hun har et netforhold til LOVE & HIP HOP's Rich Dollaz.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Én gang til
programme.desc: Efter et dødsfald i familien vifter Jessica med det hvide flag i Yandy/Mendeecees-dramaet. Erica afslører Rasheedas løgne, og Yandy spørger sig selv.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Hun kender ikke til mig
programme.desc: Ciara går totalt op i forholdet til kæresten Kwame. Men ændringer i hans opførsel får hende til at tro, at han ikke er lige så opsat.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Whitney & Tahira
programme.desc: De plejede at være bofæller på universitetet og uadskillelige.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Giftig, dysfunktionel kærlighed
programme.desc: Med et bryllup i horisonten mistænker den farverige tv-personlighed Redd, at hendes kæreste gennem ni år er utro med en kvinde, som er en fælles ven.

programme.title: Ink Master: Flasketappet
programme.desc: Tatovørerne vil slå rivalerne i lynudfordringen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chloes trediveårsdag
programme.desc: Nathan og familien fejrer Chloes 30 års fødselsdagsfest med maner! Men spændinger opstår, da James og Leah ankommer for at deltage i festen.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XXXVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness dyrker Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood nogle amatør jordflyttere i WEEKENDMASKINER.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XXXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness fejrer Rob, Steelo og Lolo Wood nogle første fald som mand og kone i FØRSTE STORE FEJLTRIN.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Lolo Wood XXXIX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness holder Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Lolo Wood hovedet høj for at undgå BOLDE FRA OVEN.

programme.title: MTV Unplugged: Lenny Kravitz: Unplugged
programme.desc: Hold fast, for nu skal vi genopleve Lenny Kravitz' ikoniske MTV Unplugged! Dette afsnit blev optaget i New York i april 1994.

programme.desc: I Kragerøs fantastiske skærgård skal Halvor og drengene forvandle et gammelt bådehus samt udearealet til et sommerparadis med smarte og kreative løsninger i ægte Hamptons-stil.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 205
programme.desc: En hytte på Lifjell i Telemark har stået uberørt et halvt århundrede og er et vidunderligt udgangspunkt for Halvor og teamet, som sætter sig for at modernisere bygningen for dens nye ejere.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 206

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 207
programme.desc: Halvor tager teamet med til den barske Trøndelag-kyst for at arbejde på en gammel butik. Stilfuld, minimalistisk renovering er i fokus, og Ole og Gustav tager en uforglemmelig tur på havet!

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 208

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 305

programme.desc: With Grayson rapidly improving after the accident, Parker asks Jane to help Kim with a malpractice lawsuit on behalf of Martha Miller, whose aspiring model daughter, Sara, died during breast implant surgery. As Kim quickly realizes that she needs Jane's help, Teri enlists Parker to defend her boyfriend, firefighter Gary Rice, when he's sued by a woman who was injured when he saved her from a burning building. But when the woman's lawyer notes that Gary lied about being a fireman, Teri feels betrayed. Meanwhile, as Stacy wonders when Fred will want to have sex, Grayson asks Jane to help with the wedding plans. Though Kim's case and the wedding are keeping her busy, Jane still finds time for a date with Grayson's doctor, Bill Kendal. As Jane advises Fred about his sex life with Stacy, and then reluctantly launches into planning the wedding that should have been hers, Gary says that when Teri mistook him for a firefighter, he didn't have the heart to say otherwise. Accepting his apology, Teri presses Parker to continue defending him. Meanwhile, though Kim and Jane prove that the SurgiCenter failed to stock a drug that could have saved Sara's life, Martha drops the lawsuit when attorney Amos Hanson reveals that an anti-depressant her daughter was taking could have killed her. While struggling to woo Stacy, Fred calls Jane during her dinner with Bill. After overhearing her advice, Bill is impressed and ends up back at her apartment for the night. Later, Jane learns that Sara was a client at an agency owned by Steven Bay, who routinely referred his models to the SurgiCenter, which he also owns. Once a dozen clients who agreed to have operations appear in court, the judge refers the case to the D.A. and tells Hanson to settle with Martha. Finally, as Fred and Stacy's sex life takes off, news that Gary started fires in order to rescue the victims leads Teri to turn him in to the police. programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: As Parker asks Kim to return to the firm and Stacy quizzes Fred about his family, Eli secretly asks Jane to keep after ZygoLife. When the judge agrees to proceed and then reverses her decision because of the statute of limitations, Jane appoints herself Eli's legal guardian to pursue the suit on his behalf. Needing proof that Molly's expectations for her son weren't met, Eli produces a letter she wrote while pregnant that articulates her feelings about the future. Meanwhile, Fred hires an actress to pose as his mom for a dinner with Stacy, but when the fake mom causes more problems than she solves, both he and Stacy agree to never see her again. Back in court, Jane presses Molly to tearfully reveal the truth about what she expected in a son, causing Eli to demand that she stop. Just as she is about to abandon the case, Jane stumbles upon a technicality that forces ZygoLife to settle while sparing Molly another traumatic day in court. Finally, stunned to find that Judge Hemmings has been assigned the strip club case, Grayson makes good on his promise to ask his permission to marry Vanessa. As Jane is celebrating her win for the Hallers, she regrets leaving a scathing message for Bill after discovering that he couldn't call because he accidentally left his phone at her apartment.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: When she's robbed as she's picking up the wedding rings, Jane (Brooke Elliott) ends up defending the critically ill thief in court. As the wedding day approaches, Parker (Josh Stamburg) drafts Grayson (Jackson Hurst) to defend an old college classmate (guest star Howard Hesseman) who's been arrested for selling camel's milk.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: After speaking to Jefferson High School's Fashion Club about modeling careers, Stacy enlists Jane to help Nina and Julia, two students who were denied a couples ticket to their senor prom because they are gay. Though it comes during a testy performance review by Parker, Jane agrees to take the pro bono case. When she threatens to file a lawsuit, the principal agrees to raise the girls' concerns with the superintendant. Meanwhile, when bailiff Hank Sullivan is ditched by his mail-order bride, Teri refers him to Grayson. And as Grayson looks to sue the matchmaking service that assured Hank that his $12,000 membership fee was well spent, Jane discovers that her new boyfriend Bill Kendal is seeing other women. While struggling with her feelings about Bill, Jane throws herself into representing Nina and Julia. After Nina's dad insists that she stop the lawsuit, a favorable ruling by the judge prompts the school to cancel the prom. As the case begins attracting a lot of publicity, Jane is blindsided when Parker takes over, and when the judge schedules the trial for the following month, Jane protests that the delay will mean that the girls won't be able to attend their prom. Meanwhile, though Grayson is sure that mail-order bride Irina Nesterenko's courtroom apology has hurt Hank's case, Kim looks to persuade another jilted husband to testify. Because of Jane's tenacity, Principal Duffy agrees to allow the girls to attend the prom as a couple if they will drop their lawsuit. However, when Duffy won't admit other gay couples too, Nina and Julia refuse to accept the principal's offer – with the full support of Nina's dad. Finally, as Jane and Stacy decide to hold their own prom for the girls and their friends, Grayson discovers that Irina conspired with the other man she jilted to rip off Hank. As Kim looks to help Grayson get over being left at the altar, Jane uses the prom she is throwing to break up with Bill.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: A computer dating service, fronting for prostitutes and their robber accomplices, starts an underworld war by stealing hot diamonds from a syndicate courier in "The Consenting Adults" on "Charlie's Angels." A prostitute supplied by a computer dating service keeps an antique dealer preoccupied while his store is burglarized of priceless art objects. One of the stolen items is a ceramic frog, stuffed with smuggled diamonds -- belonging to a ruthless crime syndicate boss. Thinking he is lying about the thefts, the enraged kingpin kidnaps the antique dealers and Charlie's Angels enter the case. Jill infiltrates the dating service posing as a hooker but finds that the prostitute involved in the burglary has led the crime boss to the diamonds. In a last ditch effort to gain evidence, Angels Sabrina and Jill disguise themselves as veterinarians and steal the syndicate chieftain's championship racehorse. The chieftain agrees to meet the Angels in a park and turn over the diamonds in exchange for his horse. In the exciting climax, Angel Jill must make a getaway with the evidence on her skateboard -- chased by a syndicate hit man Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Rich widows and widowers are hypnotized into thinking their deceased spouses still manage their business affairs from the 'other side' as "The Seance" airs on "Charlie's Angels." A spirited dowager, pressured by insurance investigators about the repeated disappearances of her jewelry, hires Charlie's Angels to solve the mystery. The girls get their first clue when the daffy old lady tells them that her dead husband manages her business affairs from the grave through a medium named Madame Dorian. Kelly assumes the identity of a rich Texas widow; Jill becomes her friend from the 'Lone Star' state and Bosley, their French chauffeur. Unbeknownst to the others, Madame Dorian's male assistant hypnotizes Kelly as he had done with previous widows -- to get financial information from her. During the trance, she reveals her true identity as a private investigator. Realizing that the con game has been uncovered, he programs Kelly to perceive Jill as a childhood "bogeyperson," so he can attempt a getaway. The hypnotized Kelly helps in his escape by keeping Charlie's team busy trying to stop her from killing Jill. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Jill becomes the hated star of a roller derby team when she goes undercover to investigate the mysterious death of a beautiful skater as "Death on Wheels" airs (day/date/time) on Channel 's "Charlie's Angels." Skating champ Karen Jason is killed after being forced over the guardrail and into the audience during a rough and tumble race. Charlie's client believes Karen was murdered, despite the police report stating that the death was accidental. In search of clues, Sabrina poses as a state insurance investigator, Kelly as a pushy writer for a national magazine and Jill as a member of the roller derby team. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels are summoned to try and stop an assassin intent on killing the members of an old French Underground team in "Angel Trap" on "Charlie's Angels." Fernando Lamas guest stars as Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man with a record of assassination dating back to the days of the World War II French Underground. He becomes the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed. From one of Jericho's ex-girlfriends, Charlie's Angels learn chat he intends to eliminate all of the members of his old French Underground team. In an attempt to capture Jericho before he can carry out his plans, Sabrina poses as the girlfriend of Kamden, the' next likely victim of the team, and Jill sets up an "accidental" meeting with Jericho. Jill soon finds it difficult to keep her mind on the job as she becomes emotionally involved with the romantic killer. She and Sabrina guess that the probable time and place of Jericho's next move will be in the city park. There, Kelly and an army of police await the inevitable. Jericho arrives in their midst, smiling confidently, carrying his pet kitten. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Jill and Kelly con a compulsive gambler out of his money in order to trap him in his usual burglary method of replenishing his gambling stakes in "The Big Tap Out," on "Charlie's Angels." When notorious gambler-thief, Roy David is suspected of burglarizing a securities company of $40,000 to replenish his gambling money, Charlie's Angels are called into the case to obtain the necessary evidence to convict him of the crime. Sabrina and Bosley dupe the gambler into betting nearly half of the loot on a losing horse at the race track. Jill then takes over the scheme at the gambling tables to cheat him out of his remaining money. With David penniless and in desperate need of renewed gambling stakes, the Angels make it easy for him to follow his usual burglary pattern. In front of startled eyes, they carefully, stage a hit-and-run accident in which Jill is apparently killed with detailed floor plans and safe combinations to the casino in her possession. David, of course, steals the plans and immediately sets up a burglary. When David tries to make his getaway from the casino with the stolen money, Kelly stops his escape by ramming her car into the back of his, thereby causing a great commotion into which the police are summoned. On the scene, police discover the cache of stolen money inside David's car, and his gambling days are over. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as "Angels in Chains" airs on the new series, "Charlie's Angels." The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a "kangaroo court" to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an "early release" and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sinister forces attempt to discredit the spokesman for free Poland in "Angels on a String," on "Charlie's Angels." An international political leader is abducted and a double substituted for him at a world conference being held at a resort where Charlie's Angels are vacationing. Having met the leader earlier, Sabrina knows something is wrong. Soon, the girls discover that the culprits plan to have their importer deliver a false, radicalized, seemingly irrational keynote address. Naturally, the press would misquote him, fatally damaging the cause. Sabrina, disguised as the hotel waitress assigned to serve the imposter, saves the life of our Assistant Secretary to State by switching away a poisoned wineglass. Dressed as a maid, Jill infiltrates the ranks of the phony FBI designated to protect him. Together the girls rescue the real politico in time for his all-important address. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Kursen er sat mod en galakse med action og eventyr uden lige, mens kaptajn Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) og hans stjerneskibsbesætning kæmper mod en farlig modstander, som har en overraskende forbindelse til Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.sub-title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.sub-title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.sub-title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.sub-title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Det er det 23. århundrede, og en rumvæsenmagt fordamper havene. For at redde menneskeheden må Kirk og hans besætning rejse tilbage til 1986, hvor de finder en verden fuld af Punk, Pizza og byttebusser, er vildfremmed for dem!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.sub-title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1306
programme.desc: Det bliver en på mange måder grænseoverskridende aften, når filmproducenten Peter Aalbæk Jensen inviterer sine gæster til middag. En aften fyldt med overraskelser og uenigheder, de sent glemmer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Det er en højlydt oplevelse på alle måder, når aftenens vært, journalist og podcastvært Ditte Okman, byder indenfor, men det er ikke alle, der lader sig imponere af ekstravagant pynt og dyre råvarer.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1308
programme.desc: Det er ikke alt, der går helt som det skal, når hardliner politikeren, Mette Thiesen inviterer sine gæster på en overraskende menu. Heldigvis kan meget reddes med lidt vand.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1309
programme.desc: Flere af gæsterne føler sig hjemme, når influencer Nynne Larsen inviterer til middag i Værebroparken. På trods af den lille lejlighed, er der plads til dybe spørgsmål.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1310
programme.desc: Sanger og radiovært Nadia Malm inviterer indenfor. Spørgsmålene er mange, for hvordan er det at dele navn med én, der blev lagt for had landet over, da dokumentaren, Den Sorte Svane, kom frem.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1311
programme.desc: Det går sjældent kedeligt for sig i selskab med realitystjerne, model og influencer Sinan Türkmen, og det gør det heller ikke, når han inviterer til middag i sit hjem på Østerbro i København.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1312
programme.desc: Selvom man bor småt, kan man godt invitere til middagsselskab. Det beviser radio- og tv-vært Helin Erdem, når hun inviterer sine gæster med til sit elskede Albertslund.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1313
programme.desc: Pizzakokken Gorm Wisweh inviterer til middag i sommerhuset ved Jægerspris. Men hvis gæsterne vil have noget at spise, må de selv hjælpe til. Tilgengæld lukker Gorm op for personlige historier.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1314
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Sille Nimholm inviterer indenfor i sit hjem i Albertslund, men ikke alle er imponeret over smagen. Værten åbner til gengæld op omkring retssager, og hvordan hun holder humøret oppe.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1315
programme.desc: TV-kendissen Linse Kessler byder på middag på sin elskede Bryggen, Islands Brygge i København. Her er plads til latter og sang, men med Linses nuværende økonomi er der ikke plads til meget mere.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1316
programme.desc: Politikeren Sikandar Siddique byder sine gæster indenfor til en oplevelse, der giver gæsterne et indblik i sin baggrund, og vi er med når Sikandar åbner op om en yderst svær periode i sit liv.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Realitystjernen Gustav Salinas byder indenfor i sin eksklusive lejlighed. Værten byder på mad fra varme lande, og lukker sine farvestrålende gæster indenfor i sit svære kærlighedsliv.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Den anerkendte filmskaber Guillermo del Toro giver den hele armen i denne sci-fi action episke fortælling om en gruppe mennesker, som slår sig sammen i år 2025 for at slås mod legioner af monstre, der stiger op fra havets dyb. Ved at bruge enorme pilot-styrede robotter til at bekæmpe den udenjordiske trussel, tager Jordens overlevende mennesker (inklusive Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day & Rinko Kikuchi) kampen op mod den invaderende udenjordiske hær, der ligger på lur i Stillehavets dybder. Næsten helt forsvarsløse mod den usårlige fjende, tvinges menneskehedens styrker til at satse på to usandsynlige helte -- en udbrændt tidligere pilot og en grøn rekrut -- som nu står som Jordens sidste håb mod verdens undergang.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Teenageren Leo Beidermann (Elijah Wood) opdager, at en komet er på vej mod Jorden. Forskere beregner hurtigt, at kometen er så stor, at den vil udslette alt liv på planeten. Den eneste måde at undgå katastrofen på er ved at plante kraftige atombomber på det gigantiske klippestykke fra rummet. Den amerikanske præsident (Morgan Freeman) sender et lille hold astronauter af sted på den vigtige mission. Under ledelse af den erfarne astronaut Spurgeon Danner (Robert Duvall) skal de plante A-bomberne. Men vil sprængningen lykkes? Og hvis ikke: hvad stiller jordens befolkning så op?
